description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Coastal Retreat!* Main House + Private Carriage House – Enjoy two separate living spaces for added privacy and flexibility* Steps from Rosemary Beach and 30A * Private Pool and Two Outdoor Courtyards – Relax poolside, lounge in the sunshine, grill, or dine outdoors* Pool Can Be Heated (additional fee)* 6 Complimentary Adult Bikes – Explore Rosemary Beach, 30A, and nearby coastal communities* Beach Chairs and Umbrellas Included – Everything you need for relaxing beach days* Private Elevator in Main House – Convenient access across the home's levels* Entertainment for Everyone – Extra-large Samsung Smart TVs, high-speed WiFi, and Xbox Series X*Whole-House 6-Stage Water Purification System – Added comfort throughout the Main House* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to Stepping Stone Main House & Carriage House, an incredible coastal retreat perfectly positioned just steps from 30A and Rosemary Beach! Combining the spacious luxury of the Main House with the privacy and charm of the Carriage House, this unique property comfortably accommodates up to 14 guests. Recently renovated with extensive upgrades and improvements, the Main House features beautiful coastal design and a brand-new private elevator. The open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area provides a spacious gathering place for everyone, while high-end appliances make preparing meals for the group easy. Step outside to enjoy the property's private pool and two outdoor courtyards. The pool can be heated for an additional fee. The Main House features three King suites with private ensuite bathrooms, two of which are master suites offering soaking tubs, showers, views, and peaceful retreat spaces. A spacious bunk room features twin-over-twin bunk beds with pull-out trundles and sleeps up to six guests. The Carriage House provides an additional private retreat, making this property especially convenient for larger groups traveling together. It features a queen bedroom, private bathroom, cozy living area with a queen sleeper sofa, and a fully equipped kitchen. The separate space gives guests the flexibility to enjoy time together while still having a private place to retreat. With an unbeatable location, private pool, spacious outdoor areas, flexible sleeping arrangements, and the added privacy of a separate Carriage House, Stepping Stone Main House and Carriage House is the perfect blend of coastal luxury, comfort, and convenience.** Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, pool/spa heater controls, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door and pool area. **The Bed Setup:Main House:2nd Floor: Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed Guest Bunk Bedroom 2: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds with Pull-Out Trundles3rd Floor: Master Bedroom 1: King Bed Master Bedroom 2: King BedCarriage House:Master Bedroom: Queen BedLiving Area: Queen Sleeper SofaArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
